entry.title: Entanglement Distribution in Quantum Switch Networks: Memory Limits and Achievability
entry.summary:
We study the minimum persistent memory required to distribute a graph state through a quantum switch. Specifically, consider a central switch that assists $n$ remote users in distributing a graph state, using independently generated user-switch Bell pairs. Since Bell-pair generation is probabilistic, different links generally succeed at different times.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #networking #combinatorics

entry.title: Grain-Boundary Scattering between Chiral Domains in Chiral Topological Semimetal CoSi
entry.summary:
We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #materials-science

entry.title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits. Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms.
entry.summary:
Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms. This article aims to bridge these paradigms by developing a method for mapping quantum-optical systems onto qubit-based quantum circuits. The key ingredient enabling this mapping is the introduction of a truncation of the Fock space describing single-mode optical states.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #compilers #optics-photonics

entry.title: Light-induced asymmetric pseudogap below the critical temperature in cuprates
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03446-6 How superconductivity relates to the pseudogap in cuprates remains unclear. Now, time-resolved photoemission measurements show a light-induced pseudogap-like state below critical temperature, revealing a dynamic interplay with superconductivity.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #condensed-matter
